description: This is a Python source file defining custom guardrail classes for the litellm framework, including load balancing test guardrails and a custom guardrail that modifies messages and checks responses.

classes.name: GuardrailForLBTestingA
classes.description: A guardrail class for load balancing testing, incrementing a call count each time it's invoked.

classes.name: GuardrailForLBTestingB
classes.description: Another load balancing test guardrail similar to the first, tracking its own call count.

classes.name: myCustomGuardrail
classes.description: A custom guardrail that masks certain words in messages, rejects calls with specific content, and rejects responses containing certain words.

methods.description: A hook running in parallel to the API call to reject calls containing specific words.
